_about: Public-domain Philip Stafford Moxom (1848-1923), Baptist and then Congregational minister in Boston and Springfield, for the Word Hoard: The Aim of Life, From Jerusalem to Nicaea, The Religion of Hope, and his sermons and addresses. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 98 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
